name: The Emerald Sword
description: Under the watchful gaze of King Eoric of Ravenhold, you have been charged with a perilous mission: to delve into the fabled Tomb of Dragonkin, a labyrinth of ancient stone and half-whispered curses. Rumors speak of traps laid by long‑dead dragon lords and guardians forged from living flame, all set to protect the legendary Emerald Sword—a blade said to pulse with the very breath of dragons. Armed with little more than your courage and the king’s solemn blessing, you must navigate forgotten halls and test your mettle against the echoes of draconic power to claim this prize for Ravenhold.
